description: Job Title: Regulatory Compliance Specialist Job Description This role interprets and applies federal, state, and international regulations to products, financial processes, and operational procedures, ensuring full compliance with applicable laws and regulatory requirements. The Regulatory Compliance Specialist develops and implements policies and procedures, supports regulatory reporting, and partners with internal stakeholders to resolve compliance issues and enhance overall compliance awareness across the organization. Responsibilities Interpret federal, state, and international regulations and apply them to products, financial processes, and operational practices. Develop, implement, and maintain policies and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable statutes, regulations, and internal standards. Ensure regulatory reporting requirements are met accurately and on time. Investigate and resolve compliance problems, questions, or complaints received from internal departments, customers, and government regulatory agencies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address compliance issues and implement corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement programs to increase employee awareness and knowledge of compliance policies and regulatory obligations. Conduct audits and assessments of policies, procedures, and documentation to evaluate compliance with government laws and regulations. Prepare clear documentation and reports summarizing audit findings, compliance risks, and recommended improvements. Monitor changes in relevant laws and regulations and support updates to policies and processes as needed. Support ongoing risk management activities by identifying compliance risks and recommending mitigation strategies. Essential Skills Demonstrated experience interpreting and applying federal, state, and/or international regulations to business processes and practices. Proven experience conducting audits and assessments related to compliance with government laws and regulations. Strong knowledge of compliance, audit, regulatory, risk management, and regulatory compliance practices. Ability to develop, implement, and maintain compliance policies and procedures. Skill in investigating and resolving compliance problems, questions, and complaints. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail. Effective written and verbal communication skills for interacting with internal stakeholders and external regulatory agencies. Bachelor's degree in a related field and 3 years of relevant professional experience, or 9 years as a qualified RCT at NNS. Alternatively, a Master's degree in a related field and 1 year of relevant professional experience. US citizenship. Additional Skills & Qualifications Experience developing and delivering programs to increase employee awareness and understanding of compliance policies. Experience in risk management with the ability to identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risks. Experience

Job Title: Labor Compliance Specialist – Certified Payroll Job Description This role focuses on ensuring full labor and payroll compliance across multiple construction projects by actively monitoring certified payroll records, managing subcontractor setup and documentation in a labor compliance platform, and supporting internal and external audits. The position works closely with subcontractors, field teams, consultants, and project managers to verify adherence to federal, IRA, and construction-related labor requirements and to provide clear, data-driven compliance reporting. Responsibilities Actively monitor certified payroll records on a weekly basis and review subcontractor submissions in the labor compliance platform (LCPtracker). Review each certified payroll report in LCPtracker, including those from lower-tier subcontractors, to confirm that all required documentation is received and complete. Issue notifications to subcontractors regarding deficiencies or missing information and alert field teams when subcontractors are non-compliant. Make informed recommendations for withholding payment when subcontractors do not meet labor compliance requirements. Manage the subcontractor setup process in the labor compliance platform, including issuing welcome packets outlining compliance requirements. Add subcontractors to LCPtracker, assign them to the appropriate projects, and ensure all major scope subcontractors are properly associated with projects under construction. Assist the team with drafting site-specific Project Determination Summaries to document applicable wage and compliance requirements. Identify wage tables that need to be created or updated in LCPtracker, coordinate their creation with the team, and assign the correct wage tables to each project. Assist with adding new users to LCPtracker and ensuring they have appropriate access and guidance. Oversee the general labor compliance email inbox, respond to subcontractor inquiries, and screen or assign emails to the appropriate team members as needed. Act as a liaison between third-party consultants, subcontractors, and the internal Labor Compliance Team to facilitate clear communication and timely issue resolution. Maintain a subcontractor compliance log for each project to track labor compliance status and support project managers in determining eligibility for invoice approvals. Resolve certified payroll reporting inquiries from both internal stakeholders and external clients. Assist with external certified payroll audits and other requests from third parties, ensuring accurate and timely responses. Attend compliance meetings and trainings focused on IRA bill compliance, Department of Labor payroll requirements, and apprenticeship requirements, and apply this knowledge to daily work. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of contractual obligations in order to effectively audit incoming certified payroll documents. Provide monthly compliance summaries for each project to support

Job Title: Configuration Analyst Job Description The Configuration Analyst plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of product configuration data across the full lifecycle of aerospace programs. This position evaluates engineering modifications and product updates, manages configuration records, supports change control activities, and collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to maintain compliant, well-controlled baselines for complex systems. Responsibilities Evaluate engineering modifications and product updates to identify impacts on system baselines, documentation, manufacturing processes, and released configurations. Coordinate the processing, review, and implementation of engineering changes, revisions, waivers, deviations, and product updates through established procedures. Maintain configuration records and ensure accuracy of product structure information throughout the lifecycle of assigned programs. Support change control activities by preparing complete documentation packages and facilitating approvals through formal review processes. Generate reports and metrics to track configuration status, document revisions, and program-level change activity. Assist with planning and execution of configuration audits and product baseline reviews to verify compliance and data integrity. Collaborate with engineering, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, and program teams to maintain data consistency and configuration integrity across all systems. Review technical documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal standards and customer requirements. Administer product configuration data within applicable enterprise systems and configuration management tools, including PLM and PDM platforms. Support design reviews, production readiness reviews, and other technical gate activities that require accurate configuration data and traceability. Create, update, and maintain product relationships, bill-of-material (BOM) structures, and associated traceability records. Research technical information, including components, materials, specifications, and industry standards, to support configuration decisions. Provide guidance to stakeholders on document control, revision management, and engineering change procedures. Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency, compliance, and configuration control processes, and contribute to implementing enhancements. Remain current on industry best practices, standards, and technologies related to product lifecycle and configuration management. Contribute to special projects and other operational initiatives as assigned, supporting broader configuration management objectives. Essential Skills Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting configuration management, document control, product lifecycle management (PLM), engineering change management, or a related technical discipline. Hands-on experience with PLM and PDM systems for managing product configuration a

Job Title: Data Analyst Job Description This Data Analyst role focuses on transforming clinical and laboratory data into meaningful insights that support high-quality healthcare decisions. You will work in an inclusive, collaborative environment where diverse perspectives are valued and every team member has the opportunity to contribute. In this position, you apply your medical laboratory experience and statistical expertise to import, assess, and maintain clinical data, ensuring it meets strict regulatory and quality standards. If you are detail-oriented, passionate about data, and motivated to improve patient care through accurate and reliable information, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact. Responsibilities Enter, create, maintain, and archive designated master data within your area of responsibility with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Import clinical data from field operations and ensure it is correctly structured, complete, and ready for analysis. Utilize statistical application software, including EP Evaluator and Microsoft Excel, to analyze clinical and laboratory data. Apply CLIA and other relevant regulatory requirements to assess data for compliance and monitor its quality. Review data to ensure quality standards are met for internal stakeholders and external customers, providing feedback and guidance as needed. Contribute to the development and support of automated and efficient data-driven decision-making processes across the organization. Use your understanding of databases and data structures to organize data effectively, including tables, hierarchical structures, and flat files. Identify data issues, inconsistencies, or gaps and collaborate with relevant teams to resolve them and improve data integrity. Take calculated risks and implement new ideas and process improvements within established parameters and regulatory guidelines. Prioritize and manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining high quality standards. Communicate findings, trends, and insights clearly through written reports and oral presentations to technical and non-technical audiences. Support chemistry laboratory verification and inspection activities by providing accurate data and documentation as needed. Ensure all data handling and documentation align with applicable regulatory checklists and laboratory verification expectations. Essential Skills Medical Laboratory Medicine degree with a minimum of 5 years of experience. Advanced working knowledge of EP Evaluator statistical software. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting. Strong understanding of database fundamentals and data structures, including tables, hierarchical structures, and flat files. Experience with data analysis in a clinical or laboratory environment. Strong organizational and planning skills with the ability to prioritize and handle multiple functions at one time. Job Title: Environmental Monitoring Analyst I Job Description A global bio-pharmaceutical company specializing in generic sterile injectable manufacturing is seeking motivated individuals to join their Environmental Monitoring Team. The role involves viable and non-viable monitoring of manufacturing areas, including air, water, and surface sampling. Analysts will log samples in a proprietary LIMS and adhere to cGMP documentation practices. They will also process water, product, and commodity samples and perform bioburden testing. Responsibilities Conduct viable and non-viable monitoring of manufacturing areas. Perform air, water, and surface sampling. Log samples in a proprietary LIMS and adhere to cGMP documentation practices. Process water, product, and commodity samples. Perform bioburden testing. Assist in training new hires and integrating them into the pharmaceutical industry. Act as an interim lead for supervisors as needed. Participate in process improvement initiatives. Essential Skills Bachelor's degree in Microbiology, Biology, or related life science field with 0-1+ years of pharmaceutical industry experience in environmental monitoring. Associate's degree or HS diploma with 1-2 years of environmental monitoring experience in the pharmaceutical industry. Experience in gowning and sampling in an aseptic manufacturing environment. Additional Skills & Qualifications Previous experience with LIMS for a smoother learning curve. Familiarity with MODA sample tracking system. Knowledge of pharmaceutical lab setup. Understanding of cGMP manufacturing and clean room practices. Experience in aseptic lab processing and aseptic sampling. Work Environment The role is based in a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment, requiring interaction with both the manufacturing floor and the laboratory. Candidates need to be available to work days or nights, with a preference indicated in their application. The department operates on a 2,2,3 rotating schedule with 12-hour shifts. Gowning in Grade A, B, C, D areas is necessary, and candidates must be comfortable with tight spaces and adhering to dress code restrictions such as no makeup, fake nails, or jewelry. Training is comprehensive and involves working with specific team trainers over several months. Job Type & Location This is a Contract position based out of Wake Forest, NC. Pay and Benefits The pay range for this position is $23.00 - $25.00/hr. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. If eligible, the benefits available for this temporary role may include the following: • Medical, dental & vision • Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Pre-tax and Roth post-tax contributions available • Life Insurance (Voluntary Life & AD&D for the employee and dependents) • Short and long-term disability • Health Spend

Job Title: Environmental Monitoring Analyst I Job Description The Environmental Monitoring Analyst I supports a global bio-pharmaceutical sterile injectable manufacturing operation by performing viable and non-viable environmental monitoring across classified manufacturing areas. This role focuses on air, water, and surface sampling, accurate sample logging in a laboratory information management system (LIMS), and strict adherence to cGMP and clean room practices. The analyst processes water, product, and commodity samples, performs bioburden testing, and contributes directly to maintaining a controlled aseptic manufacturing environment. This position offers a strong entry point into pharmaceutical microbiology with clear pathways for growth into advanced analyst, trainer, and supervisory roles within a large, well-established environmental monitoring and microbiology team. Responsibilities Perform viable and non-viable environmental monitoring of manufacturing areas, including air, water, and surface sampling in aseptic and classified cleanroom environments. Collect, handle, and transport samples from Grade A, B, C, and D areas while following aseptic sampling techniques and clean room practices. Log all samples accurately and promptly in a proprietary LIMS and related sample tracking systems, ensuring data integrity and compliance with cGMP documentation standards. Process water, pharmaceutical product, and commodity samples in the laboratory, including preparation and execution of bioburden testing. Conduct bioburden testing on water and pharmaceutical product samples and perform testing on commodities for viable and non-viable particulates. Follow cGMP manufacturing and aseptic lab processing procedures to support sterile injectable production and maintain a state of control in the manufacturing environment. Collaborate closely with other microbiology laboratories by collecting and delivering samples on time so downstream testing can be completed as scheduled. Adhere to clean room gowning requirements and aseptic techniques, including working comfortably in tight spaces and complying with all restrictions on personal items while sampling. Participate in structured training, including completion of training qualifications (TQs), and work with designated team trainers to become certified on routine job tasks. Support process improvement initiatives within the environmental monitoring function by following updated procedures and contributing feedback on workflows and techniques. Demonstrate flexibility with shift schedules and daily plans to accommodate operational needs, unexpected events, or changes in sampling priorities. Work effectively within a large environmental monitoring team across day and night shifts, collaborating with supervisors and fellow analysts to meet sampling and testing requirements. Job Title: Lab Research Analyst I Job Description The Lab Research Analyst I is a hands-on laboratory scientist who supports the development of new vaccines and therapeutics by studying immune responses. This role focuses on receiving and processing samples from preclinical and clinical studies, performing complex immunology and molecular biology experiments, and generating high-quality data that informs vaccine research. The position requires meticulous bench work, consistent execution of detailed protocols, and close collaboration with scientists and laboratory leadership in a fast-paced, mission-driven research environment. Responsibilities Receive and process human, macaque, and mouse samples from vaccine studies and clinical trials, ensuring careful handling and accurate tracking of all specimens. Isolate, enrich, culture, and sequence B cells to evaluate antibody responses following immunization. Perform cell culture work, including establishing and maintaining primary cell cultures under defined conditions. Conduct molecular biology techniques such as nucleic acid extraction, RNA extraction, RT-PCR, PCR, qPCR, and related workflows to support immunology and vaccine research. Prepare samples for next-generation sequencing (NGS), following established protocols to preserve sample quality and integrity. Execute single-cell B-cell isolation and antibody gene sequencing workflows involving thousands of individual cell samples with a high degree of precision. Run immunological assays, including ELISA, bead-based immunoassays, immunofluorescence staining, and microscopy-based analyses to characterize immune responses. Utilize flow cytometry for cell sorting and analysis and contribute to data interpretation using tools such as FlowJo and GraphPad Prism where applicable. Support recombinant antibody production, purification, and quality control activities to generate high-quality reagents for research studies. Maintain detailed, accurate experimental documentation and electronic records, ensuring all work complies with standard operating procedures (SOPs) and laboratory quality standards. Collaborate closely with scientists, laboratory leadership, and support staff to achieve project milestones and meet regulatory and FDA-related timelines. Assist with general laboratory operations, including equipment upkeep, routine maintenance, reagent preparation, inventory control, and supply tracking. Follow rigorous contamination-control practices and execute repetitive, highly detailed laboratory workflows consistently to maintain data integrity. Work effectively with advanced robotics and sequencing equipment by adhering to established workflows and contributing to continuous process improvements. Essential Skills Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Immunology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Zoology, Botany, Psychology, or a closely related scientific discipline. Minimum of 2 years of laboratory research experience; a Master’s degree may substitute for this e

Job Title: Quality Analyst – Inventory & Materials Control Job Description The Quality Analyst – Inventory & Materials Control ensures the accuracy, quality, and traceability of materials issued from the warehouse to the manufacturing floor in a high-volume production environment. This role focuses on validating work order material requests, monitoring replenishment triggers, and confirming that materials are correctly backfilled to work centers. The position is part of a critical process improvement initiative and offers strong potential to grow into a long-term opportunity as the organization continues to enhance inventory hygiene and scalable manufacturing processes. Responsibilities Validate work order material requests to ensure accuracy, completeness, and alignment with production requirements. Monitor replenishment triggers and ensure timely movement of materials from the warehouse to the manufacturing floor. Confirm that all materials are correctly backfilled to work centers, maintaining accurate traceability for each work order. Track materials using bills of materials (BOMs), including part numbers, serial numbers, and lot numbers, to support full traceability. Work hands-on within a production or warehouse setting to verify material counts, locations, and movements. Use ERP and/or warehouse management systems (WMS) to review, update, and reconcile work orders and inventory records. Support inventory analysis activities to identify discrepancies, improve accuracy, and enhance overall inventory hygiene. Apply high attention to detail and compliance-focused practices to ensure adherence to quality and logistics standards, including AS9100 guidelines where applicable. Collaborate closely with production, materials, and logistics teams to ensure that materials availability supports production schedules. Contribute to continuous improvement efforts aimed at developing scalable, repeatable manufacturing and materials control processes. Assist with or perform data analysis on large material datasets, using advanced Excel tools such as pivot tables, when needed to support better auditing and decision-making. Maintain clear documentation of materials movements, work order changes, and inventory adjustments to support audits and traceability requirements. Essential Skills 3–5+ years of relevant experience in logistics, materials management, inventory control, or a closely related field Hands-on experience working in a manufacturing environment, production floor, or warehouse setting. Strong proficiency with work order processes and documentation in a manufacturing context. Experience tracking materials using bills of materials (BOMs), including part numbers, serial numbers, and lot numbers. Hands-on experience with ERP systems and/or warehouse management systems (WMS). Job Title: Security Compliance Analyst Job Description The Security Compliance Analyst leads the full certification lifecycle for key security frameworks, acting as the primary bridge between technical engineering teams and external auditors. This role focuses on managing ISO and SOC 2 Type 2 audits end-to-end, translating complex technical environments into audit-ready evidence, and using AI and automation to reduce the compliance burden on engineering teams. The ideal candidate is a hands-on compliance practitioner who understands the realities of SaaS products and can clearly articulate technical control requirements to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Responsibilities Own and drive the full lifecycle of ISO and SOC 2 Type 2 audits, from initial planning through final reporting. Define detailed audit requirements and translate control language into clear, actionable technical requests for engineering teams. Request, collect, and organize evidence from technical owners, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and audit readiness. Review and validate the integrity and sufficiency of technical evidence, identifying gaps, inconsistencies, or invalid submissions. Track remediation activities for identified gaps and follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely closure of issues. Serve as the primary liaison with external audit firms, speaking the language of auditors and effectively defending the control environment. Create and maintain an annual audit calendar, including timelines, milestones, and preparation activities for audit windows. Ensure the organization is well prepared for audits by coordinating pre-audit reviews, walkthroughs, and readiness assessments. Utilize AI and large language models to automate evidence collection, parse system logs, draft control descriptions, and identify potential compliance gaps before audits. Apply a human-in-the-loop approach to AI usage by critically reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs for accuracy and completeness. Review technical configuration reports for infrastructure, networking, containers, and databases to determine whether settings align with secure configuration expectations. Research and identify appropriate secure configurations and control implementations for technologies not previously encountered. Clearly explain to engineers what specific evidence or configurations are required, using precise technical language rather than generic control descriptions. Collaborate with engineering and security teams to define and refine technical controls that align with ISO, SOC 2 Type 2, and other relevant frameworks. Communicate complex compliance requirements in clear, accessible terms to non-technical stakeholders across the organization. Push back constructively on auditors when appropriate, providing reasoned explanations and evidence to support the existing control environment. Contribute to the continuous improvement of compliance processes by identifying opportunities to streamline
